summary_en: The Chiba Bank authorized the acquisition of up to 7.5 million shares, representing 1.09% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum of 15 billion yen from November 10, 2026 to January 29, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decisions on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
The Chiba Bank resolved on November 9, 2026 to acquire treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act. The bank authorized the acquisition of up to 7.5 million ordinary shares, representing 1.09% of the 685,807,629 issued shares (excluding treasury stock as of October 31, 2026), for a maximum outlay of 15 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from November 10, 2026 through January 29, 2027.

The company stated the purpose of the acquisition is to enhance capital efficiency and enrich profit returns to shareholders. The specific acquisition method is not disclosed in this announcement. As of the announcement date, the bank held 89,713,458 treasury shares.
